message: test(presentation): run interaction fixtures at explicit native client dimensions
purpose: Keep the native-pixel rendering mode and every existing interaction assertion. Initialize supported physical window dimensions before placing fixture controls. The old implicit headless window only worked because canvas_items stretched the project viewport. Do not hide HUD controls or relax routing, equipment, ownership or layout assertions.
